finding: CONSUMED FACT (toggle COUNT): holding Space on a focused, unchecked CheckBox for BOTH 1.0s and 2.5s produced exactly ONE KeyDown(32), one KeyUp(32), one Change(Value True), one Click(Value True) (a 6-row log incl. the Initialize + TextBox1 Enter setup rows). The toggle fires EXACTLY ONCE and does not multiply with hold time -- MSForms does not flood per-OS-repeat re-toggles for a held checkbox Space. esq.12 consumes ONLY this toggle-count fact (gating the keyboard CheckBox toggle on !KeyRepeat.is_repeat). CAVEATS: (1) not separately confirmed that the genuine OS key-hold emitted repeat WM_KEYDOWNs; the identical 1.0s vs 2.5s output is the evidence the toggle does not multiply. (2) INTRA-PRESS ORDER DIVERGENCE -- this held capture logged KeyDown -> KeyUp -> Change -> Click with value_after=False at KeyDown, the INVERSE of the esq.8 discrete-press capture (checkbox-keyboard-toggle-20260627T220935Z: Change -> Click -> KeyDown(value True) -> KeyUp, value-first). esq.8 value-first stands for discrete keystrokes and is what the reducer implements; whether the held order is genuinely press-duration-dependent or an artifact of the vision-driven hold/release interleaving is UNSETTLED and is NOT consumed by esq.12.
driving_method: Computer-use hold_key (genuine OS key-hold) on a background-COM-hosted Excel; the fixture VBA logged events to the W008HeldKeyLog worksheet, exported to CSV. Two runs (1.0s and 2.5s holds) produced identical logs; one representative copy is recorded here.
non_claims: Scenario coverage reports observed worksheet rows in this run only.
held_enter_default (a held default-button Enter) was NOT captured this session and is deferred to a follow-up bead (oxforms-esq.15); not_observed_in_this_run is not a negative MSForms fact.

esq.12 consumes ONLY the toggle-COUNT fact (one Change/Click regardless of hold time), NOT the intra-press dispatch ORDER: the held order (KeyDown -> KeyUp -> Change -> Click) diverges from the esq.8 value-first discrete-press order and is unsettled, so it is not inherited by future beads.
No OxForms runtime behavior is claimed by the capture (oxforms-esq.12 consumes it).
